query: Vilka avtal begränsar ansvaret för skada?
classify_question: Innehåller texten en avtalsenlig ansvarsbegränsning, till exempel ett takbelopp eller ett undantag för indirekt skada?
notes: Passage gold is an operative contractual cap or exclusion of indirect loss. A heading without a limit, a statutory GDPR allocation, a parking/car disclaimer, and a carve-out sentence that only names exceptions are not passage-relevant. Document gold is the contract that contains at least one such passage. Corrected after C@8: Jev YES on genuine caps that the first gold omitted were added; YES on operational disclaimers and insurance schedules were not.
